mesures.texte: Your piece does not exist before you order it. It is made to order, in the size you have chosen, and nothing lies waiting in stock.

dentelle.texte: In Hypnotic Lace, black lace takes the waist, the bust or the shoulder. On some pieces, gold mingles with it.

point.texte: Our pieces are made by French artisans. The Maison takes care of their working conditions and of the recognition their craft deserves.

finitions.texte: Once finished, the piece receives its creation number, written on its certificate of authenticity. Then it is on its way to you.
